primary_meta_qois: zero positive/conditional future verdicts survive with missing or invalid packet
all historical candidate verdicts remain unchanged

valid packet does not create promotion by itself
negative_controls: synthetic positive candidate pointing to unknown packet id

legacy_cutoff_rule: Only the exact candidate ids already present at parent_main_sha may be LEGACY_PRE_PACKET. Any successor or revalidation uses a new id and requires a packet.
